plugin.note: Ice giants have very low defence and are weak to fire (100%), so almost any strong weapon works. Use low-risk Wilderness gear such as Viggora's chainmace; a Dwarf multicannon speeds the Wilderness Slayer Cave level 67 variant. Keep a one-click escape teleport ready.

requirements: A one-click teleport for emergency escape
Optional Dwarf multicannon for the Wilderness Slayer Cave variant
mechanics: Ice giants use melee (slash) with a max hit of about 7 (10 for the level 67 variant).
Ice giants are weak to fire (100%) and have very low defence.
All Krystilia ice giant kills must occur in the Wilderness.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave is multicombat, cannonable, and a popular player-killing hotspot.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Kill Wilderness ice giants with a fast low-risk weapon; cannon the cave variant for speed.
recommendedFor: fast cannon XP in the Wilderness Slayer Cave
steps: Bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport.
Use the Frozen Waste Plateau spawns for a quiet area, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave for a cannonable multicombat variant.
Kill ice giants quickly; their low defence means gear choice matters less than survivability.
Watch the minimap for player killers and teleport if threatened.
notes: The level 67 cave variant grants more Slayer XP and stacks well with a cannon.
Ice giants are weak to fire spells if training Magic.

methods.label: Cannon the Wilderness Slayer Cave variant
methods.summary: Use a Dwarf multicannon on the multicombat level 67 ice giants for fast XP.
recommendedFor: players comfortable in the Wilderness Slayer Cave
steps: Enter the Wilderness Slayer Cave and set up a cannon on the level 67 ice giants.
Melee alongside the cannon to maximise kills per tick.
Stand as far south as practical to stay near one-click teleport range.
Teleport immediately if a player killer enters the cave.
notes: The cave is multicombat, so the cannon hits several giants at once.
Do not risk items you are unwilling to lose in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
